component.name: MouseDrive
component.summary: Drive racing games with your mouse

description.p: MouseDrive turns mouse and keyboard input into a virtual wheel for racing simulators. On Linux it reads mice through evdev and creates a joystick through the kernel's uinput, so games see it like any other wheel, including Windows games under Proton or Wine.

ul.li: Steering from mouse movement with five modes, from linear to adaptive filtering
Throttle and brake on the mouse buttons with editable envelope curves
Profiles per car and track, undo and an A/B comparison while driving
A Setup window that checks every requirement and shows the commands that fix it

description.p: The one-time setup installs a udev rule that lets the user of the active session use /dev/uinput and read mice.

screenshot.caption: Overview with the live output of steering, throttle and brake
